cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Expand Your Jurisdiction
cards.instruction: Use every new problem as a reason to expand what you are entitled to control.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I copied your red tag onto my key. I need it to control the kitchen; Accounts keeps missing tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Red marks a spare, not a master key. It'll open the kitchen, but the cleaners lock the kettle in their cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the spare. Give me approval of their checklist as well, so the kettle stays out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their contractor only takes instructions from the building manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then send the manager's instructions through me. I can't keep Accounts supplied if someone else can order the kettle away.

reason: Copy key color as broad access, then B two real limits fuel demands for checklist and manager control.
